cover_image.alt: A Śaiva emblem — trident through lotus and sun within a stepped yantra border

meta.back_cover: Thirty-six prayers for the moments of the day — eight moments and a clockless pocket for anytime. Each verse faces its explanation: when to say it, how, and how to know it is working. Nothing here needs belief; the verses were built to be said — at the sink, at the desk, in the queue, in the dark.
